description: This file contains a Kivy application demonstrating the use of RoundedRectangle and Ellipse graphics with various parameters, including radii, segments, and textures.

classes.name: RoundedRectangleWidget
classes.description: A custom Widget that prepares and draws various RoundedRectangles and Ellipses with different parameters.

classes.name: DrawRoundedRectanglesApp
classes.description: A Kivy App that builds a widget with a canvas containing multiple RoundedRectangles and Ellipses, demonstrating different styling options.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Sets up the canvas with various colored and textured RoundedRectangles and Ellipses with different radii, segments, and sizes.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the main widget, loads additional kv language string, and adds it to the widget.
